metadata.name: map_generator
metadata.description: Map Generator Program for deterministic procedural dungeon generation

instructions.name: close_generated_map
docs: Closes the GeneratedMap account, returning rent to player.
Used by session-manager CPI during end_session to clean up.
Authorization: Reads session account to verify session_signer matches signer,
then returns rent to session.player.

accounts.name: session
docs: Game session PDA to verify session_signer authorization

accounts.name: player
docs: Player wallet receives the rent refund (not a signer)

accounts.name: session_signer
docs: Session key signer must sign to authorize closure

instructions.name: close_map_vrf_state
docs: Closes MapVrfState account and returns rent to the player.
Called via CPI from session-manager during end_session/abandon_session.

instructions.name: close_session_discovery
docs: Closes the SessionDiscovery account, returning rent to player.

instructions.name: consume_map_vrf
docs: Marks MapVrfState as consumed after VRF randomness has been used.
Called via CPI from session-manager during PvP session start.

instructions.name: delegate_generated_map
docs: Delegates generated-map PDA to MagicBlock from its owning program.

instructions.name: delegate_map_vrf_state
docs: Delegates MapVrfState PDA to MagicBlock from its owning program.

instructions.name: delegate_session_discovery
docs: Delegates SessionDiscovery PDA to MagicBlock from its owning program.

instructions.name: fill_map_for_campaign
docs: Fills the map for a campaign level using the on-chain MapConfig seed.
This keeps the campaign seed private from the client while still using
deterministic generation on the Ephemeral Rollup.

accounts.name: session_discovery
docs: Optional SessionDiscovery to populate with initial map data.

instructions.name: fill_map_with_seed
docs: Fills the map with a deterministic seed. Used for PvE campaign sessions on ER.
Must be called after init_map_account and delegation (runs on Ephemeral Rollup).

accounts.name: session_discovery
docs: Optional SessionDiscovery to populate with initial map data.

instructions.name: fulfill_map_vrf
docs: Oracle callback: receives VRF randomness and writes it to state.
TODO: Verify vrf_program_identity signer when ephemeral-vrf-sdk is available.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Oracle identity signer.

instructions.name: generate_map
docs: Generates a map for a game session based on the campaign level.
Uses the seed from map_config for the given level.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for rent

accounts.name: session
docs: Game session PDA reference (validated externally)

accounts.name: map_config
docs: Map configuration with seeds

accounts.name: generated_map
docs: Generated map output

instructions.name: generate_map_with_seed
docs: Generates a map for a game session using an explicit seed.
Used by Duels so seed selection is decoupled from campaign progression.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for rent

accounts.name: session
docs: Game session PDA reference (validated externally)

accounts.name: map_config
docs: Map configuration with seeds

accounts.name: generated_map
docs: Generated map output

instructions.name: generate_map_with_vrf
docs: Generates the map using VRF-derived randomness. Used for Gauntlet/Duel sessions on ER.
Must be called after VRF fulfillment on the Ephemeral Rollup.

accounts.name: session_discovery
docs: Optional SessionDiscovery to populate with initial map data.

instructions.name: init_map_account
docs: Allocates an empty GeneratedMap account without generating any maze content.
Called via CPI from session-manager during session start so the account
exists and can be delegated to ER. Actual maze generation happens on ER
via fill_map_with_seed (PvE) or generate_map_with_vrf (Gauntlet/Duel).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for rent

accounts.name: session
docs: Game session PDA reference

accounts.name: generated_map
docs: Generated map output (allocated empty, filled on ER)

instructions.name: init_map_vrf_state
docs: Pre-creates MapVrfState PDA on base chain without requesting randomness.
Used to initialize the account before delegation to ER, so VRF requests
on the Ephemeral Rollup don't need to create new accounts inline.

instructions.name: init_session_discovery
docs: Allocates an empty SessionDiscovery account.
Called via CPI from session-manager during session start.

instructions.name: initialize_map_config
docs: Initializes the map configuration with default seed mappings.
Each level i gets seed value i as default.

instructions.name: mark_poi_used
docs: Marks a POI as used on the generated map.

accounts.name: generated_map
docs: Generated map output

accounts.name: session
docs: Game session PDA reference (validated by owner + has_one)

instructions.name: record_discovered_poi
docs: Records a discovered POI in SessionDiscovery.
Called via CPI from poi-system when a POI is discovered.

instructions.name: request_map_vrf
docs: Requests VRF randomness for map generation.
Initializes a MapVrfState account with status=Requested.

accounts.name: session
docs: This may be called before session account initialization.

instructions.name: reveal_manhattan_radius
docs: Persists discovery using a Manhattan-distance diamond.

accounts.name: session_discovery
docs: Optional SessionDiscovery for dual-write of discovered tile types.

instructions.name: reveal_radius
docs: Persists map discovery around the provided position.
Authorization: session_signer must match the owning session signer.

accounts.name: session_discovery
docs: Optional SessionDiscovery for dual-write of discovered tile types.

instructions.name: set_tile_floor
docs: Converts a wall tile to a floor tile, authorized by gameplay-state.
This instruction is called via CPI from gameplay-state when a player
breaks through a wall. The change persists for the entire session,
so future movement to this tile costs only 1 move (floor cost).
Authorization: Requires gameplay_authority PDA as signer.

accounts.name: generated_map
docs: Generated map to modify

accounts.name: session
docs: Game session PDA reference (validated by has_one)

accounts.name: gameplay_authority
docs: Gameplay authority PDA from gameplay-state that must sign
This ensures only gameplay-state can call this instruction

accounts.name: session_discovery
docs: Optional SessionDiscovery to update tile type when a discovered wall becomes floor.

instructions.name: undelegate_generated_map
docs: Commits and undelegates generated-map PDA from ER back to base layer.

instructions.name: undelegate_session_discovery
docs: Commits and undelegates SessionDiscovery PDA from ER back to base layer.

instructions.name: update_active_offer
docs: Updates the active offer data in SessionDiscovery.
Called via CPI from poi-system when an offer is generated, rerolled, or consumed.

instructions.name: update_boss_id
docs: Updates the current boss ID in SessionDiscovery.
Called via CPI from gameplay-state at sync_map_enemies and week transitions.
Authorization: Requires gameplay_authority PDA as signer.

instructions.name: update_current_echo
docs: Updates the current gauntlet echo in SessionDiscovery.
Called via CPI from gameplay-state at sync_map_enemies and week transitions.
Authorization: Requires gameplay_authority PDA as signer.

instructions.name: update_discovered_enemies
docs: Overwrites discovered enemies in SessionDiscovery.
Called via CPI from gameplay-state after movement reveals new tiles.
Authorization: Requires gameplay_authority PDA as signer.

types.name: GeneratedMap
docs: Generated map account storing tiles, enemies, and POI positions.
PDA seeds: ["generated_map", session.key()]
**Persistence invariant:** This account is session-scoped and its layout
(including `packed_tiles`) persists unchanged across week transitions.
Week advancement in gameplay-state only modifies `GameState.week` —
`packed_tiles` is never reset. Wall-to-floor conversions via `set_floor()`
write directly to `packed_tiles` and persist for the entire session.

types.name: SessionDiscovery
docs: Player-readable account containing only discovered map data.
Private ER accounts (GeneratedMap, MapPois, MapEnemies) are unreadable via RPC;
the client reads this account for fog-of-war rendering.
PDA seeds: ["session_discovery", session.key()]

types.name: VrfStatus
docs: VRF request lifecycle stage.
Shared across all programs that manage VRF state accounts.
Each program defines its own `#[account] VrfState` struct using this enum.
